title: Allure — Instance
description: Health and usage of an Allure instance, from the /metrics exporter (PLAN_METRICS.md).

list.name: Version change
list.expr: count by (version) (allure_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) unless count by (version) (allure_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} offset 10m)

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the scraped web process started.

panels.title: Stale workers
panels.description: Solid Queue processes whose heartbeat has expired.

panels.title: Oldest delivery
panels.description: Age of the oldest federated delivery still open (pending, retrying, delivering, reconciling).

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, controller, action) (rate(rails_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m]))))

panels.title: Latency by queue
panels.description: Age of the oldest ready execution. route_images is slow by design (Chromium).

panels.title: Recurring tasks: last run
panels.description: Thresholds: orange beyond 65 min (hourly tasks), red beyond 26 h (daily tasks).

panels.title: Finished deliveries (per hour)
panels.description: Hourly change in terminal deliveries; approximate when rows are purged.

panels.title: Incoming activity
panels.description: Processed statuses are left out to keep the scale readable.

panels.title: Active (7 d)
panels.description: Accounts that created a workout or published within the window; signing in alone does not count.

panels.title: Signed in
panels.description: Accounts holding at least one open session.

panels.title: Created per day
panels.description: Change of the totals over a rolling 24 h (deletions reduce it).

panels.title: Sync by service
panels.description: 0 when no connection with automatic sync is linked.

panels.title: Two-step verification
panels.description: required: accounts past their grace period, limited to enrolment.

panels.title: Sign-in methods
panels.description: An account may count in both methods.

panels.title: Best-efforts rebuild (p95)
panels.description: persist runs under the workout's write lock.
